evidence: Reviewed the full diff. The first-line mark check (strings.Cut on the first newline, then Contains) is applied consistently in write, remove and status.
The uninstall note is built from the (removed, foreignLeft) pair. foreignLeft is exists && !removed, which is correct, and the plugin-directory and record cleanup order is unchanged.
The already-current path requires both the plugin bytes and the record bytes to match. Any other case falls through to the original write path.
The status reorder is the requested behavior. The memorycard checks still run, now after the parity marker checks.
The golden files match the new messages. The removed record fields were not read anywhere else in the diff.
